name: spear-bootstrap-persistence
description: Spear startup repair (PR #195), fresh-process persistence with Gunslinger publication disabled. Launch 1 (default modules, Gunslinger on) loads the disposable fixture save, puts a released foundation Elven Branched Spear, a production pistol bound as a battered firearm to the main character, an unbound pistol and a Standard Longsword into the party inventory, and writes a new save. Launch 2 turns the Gunslinger module off through a real panel click and saves the settings. Launch 3, a fresh process with Gunslinger off, loads the written save and must resolve every item through its released identity: the spear with its intended serialized and effective weapon-type profile, the battered pistol with its token and original owner through the product's own strict lookup and the fixed scrap price, and the unbound pistol and the longsword at native prices, with tooltip fills that do not throw.

absent: The battered origin token blueprint is unavailable
